cliAuth:exchange.reason: Requires a one-time claimed code and matching PKCE verifier before minting a session.

cliAuth:logout.reason: revokeCliCredentials validates and revokes only the presented session and its bound API key.

cliAuth:poll.reason: Requires the matching authId and PKCE challenge; only the initiating client can poll its pending login.

mcpOAuth:exchangeAuthCode.reason: Validates one-time authorization code, redirect URI, client authentication and PKCE before issuing tokens.

mcpOAuth:exchangeRefreshToken.reason: Validates a stored unrevoked refresh-token hash and its client before rotating credentials.

mcpOAuth:registerDynamicClient.reason: Anonymous DCR requires every callback to match the exact built-in or operator allowlist, or the existing narrowly scoped ChatGPT callback prefix. An initial access token additionally permits safe loopback redirects. The shared gate runs before a durable global 60/minute limit and client insert. Registration grants no workspace or tokens; Clerk-backed consent, workspace binding, PKCE S256 and existing MCP scope policy still apply.

mcpOAuth:resolveBearerToken.reason: Validates the bearer hash, expiry, revocation and active workspace before returning scoped context.

mcpOAuth:revokeToken.reason: Revokes only the record matching the supplied bearer token hash.

teams:acceptInvite.reason: Requires an existing pending invitation token and accepts only that invitation.

teams:getInviteDetails.reason: Requires an existing pending invitation token and returns only that invitation context.

webhooks:testWebhook.reason: Delegates session and tenant validation to internal.webhooks.getWebhookInternal; delivery is disabled.

workspaces:verifyMagicLink.reason: Validates the stored one-time magic-link token and expiry before creating a session.
